Statement: Students with higher CGPA are less likely to be depressed (academic stress).
Students with a friend circle are less likely to be depressed (social support).
Single students are more likely to be depressed than students in a relationship.
Students from lower-middle class families are more likely to be depressed than middle class.
Students from rich families are less likely to be depressed than middle class.
Higher monthly living cost is associated with higher depression (financial pressure).
Students living with family are less likely to be depressed than those living as bachelors.
Female students are more likely to be depressed than male students.
